descriptionHtml:
Suggestion A1 · accessibility · not counted as a bug (was P2): accessibility is not asked for by any UAT item or ticket, so this is a suggestion, not a bug (Quinn 2026-10-14)

Buttons, inputs and dropdowns have no accessible name (Nursing Home +, settings, back, close X, task done/delete, medication status dropdown); also some focus jumps to the top and small tap targets

Tickets: — · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local (visual check)

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-01/S21, OAT-06/S24b, TC-11/S20, TC-12/S20, TC-14/S22, TC-19/S21, TC-21/S20, TC-22/S20

Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S21 axe scan of both lists in their default state

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Hospital: search by name, by room, by MRN and by diagnosis each returns the correct matching patients, each field on its own. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 2; TFA-92581 AC 5)
  • U2 Hospital: sort by room, by name and by status each puts the list in the correct order. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 4; TFA-92581 AC 5)
  • U4 Nursing Home: search by name, by unit/room, by MRN and by facility each returns the correct matching residents, each field on its own. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 3; TFA-92581 AC 6)
  • U7 Nursing Home: sort by room (unit/room), by name and by status each puts the residents in the correct order. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 4; TFA-92581 AC 6)

Test design technique: Accessibility (accessibility) — Check screen-reader, keyboard, contrast and tap-size rules (axe): users with disabilities have to be able to use it too.

Given Visual lane fixture, desktop / Pixel 7 / iPhone 15 profiles

When Visual lane runs axe on the screens it captures today: hospital-list (/rounding) and nh-list (/snf, Today's Visits), as opened, no search

Then No serious/critical WCAG 2 A/AA violations. The search box and the sort control have accessible names, and so do the icon-only add / scan / settings buttons

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): axe-core serious/critical violations = 0 on hospital-list and nh-list (visual-checks.ts). This covers the default state only: search typed, no-match, All Residents and the status-message announcement are S22. report.mjs does not key visual results per scenario, so S21's verdict is read from the hospital-list and nh-list rows of the visual report

Where it ran: local visual lane (screenshots + axe); test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (automated)

S21 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Suggestion · our own check · environment local · tickets TFA-92581 ready for qa

On the Nursing Home list the '+' (add resident) and gear (Settings) buttons have no name, so VoiceOver just says 'button'; the Hospital list has the card/trash nesting problem and low-contrast text ('1 patient remaining', the date line, the Handoff button).

Evidence: visual lane, axe on desktop/iphone15/pixel7: 15 checks pass, 9 fail; button-name is critical. Oracle: serious/critical = 0 and icon-only add/scan/settings named. These are not in dev report §5, which lists only the unnamed dialogs.
